scenes.title: All open
scenes.caption: A reel is just a small file. Anyone can read it.
scenes.say: Everything behind Pixel Reel is open. A reel is just a small file. A title, and a list of scenes.

scenes.title: Draw your own
scenes.caption: The tools are there for anyone who likes to tinker.
scenes.say: If you like to tinker, the tools are all there. Make a reel of your own, and draw its pictures in code.

scenes.title: Free to use
scenes.caption: Free to use, to change, and to share.
scenes.say: It is free to use, to change, and to share. The licence is called MIT, and it is about as easygoing as licences get.

scenes.title: Come and look
scenes.caption: The code is on GitHub.
scenes.say: So come and have a look. The code is on GitHub, under the name pixel reel.
